name: Children And Parents
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as His reward, emphasizing the sacred responsibility of nurturing them (Psalms 127:3). Parents are called to lovingly instruct and discipline their children, using correction to guide them away from folly and toward a godly path (Proverbs 1:8; 13:24; 22:15; 23:13). By training a child in the way he should go, parents lay a foundation that will endure throughout the child's life, reflecting a commitment to steadfast biblical teaching and loving guidance (Proverbs 22:6).
